archetypes.name: shell-harness
archetypes.rationale: Stateful shell harness changes can leak renderer stubs or fixture state into later cases despite the narrow diff.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the new shell harness case is isolated from preceding and following cases, including temp directories, restored renderer stubs, command-substitution behavior, and reused gh shim state. Check that the assertions exercise the intended compose_self_fallback LINES_DATA_OK=true path rather than matching stale or unrelated output. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
